findings.title: Conflicting sensitivity for the same evaluation
findings.description: Reported sensitivity values (0.9500, 0.8000) for model heparisk version v2.1, endpoint hepg2_assay_positive, dataset test-01, split test are inconsistent. Confusion-matrix calculation = 0.8000.

sources.quote: Reported sensitivity: 0.80 on TEST-01 for HepaRisk v2.1.

findings.recommendation: Check the original dataset and calculation, then reconcile the reported metric.

findings.title: Conflicting intended-use model versions
findings.description: Documents identify heparisk as intended-use versions v2.0., v2.1..

sources.quote: AI model for proposed use: HepaRisk v2.1.
Intended regulatory-use model identity: HepaRisk v2.0.

findings.recommendation: Confirm and consistently identify the model version intended for this use.

findings.title: External validation claim contradicts available study evidence
findings.description: For heparisk v2.1, independent external-laboratory validation is claimed but the supplied evidence explicitly describes within-laboratory testing.

sources.quote: Claim: HepaRisk v2.1 was validated at an independent external laboratory.
separate batches. The test dataset is not an external-laboratory dataset.

findings.recommendation: Identify the actual validation institution or withdraw the unsupported assertion.

sources.quote: There is no record here of prespecified performance acceptance criteria.

findings.recommendation: Provide a dated, context-appropriate prespecified evaluation protocol or explain missing records.
